notation: Workgroup 0 (the producer, one wave of 32 lanes) runs to its end, then workgroup 1 (the consumer), as the single-machine runner does. Buffers d (data), f (flags), o (output) start at 0. Producer ops: data (each lane stores 7 at d[4 l], wave scope), wait (the store counter's wait, count 0), flag_atomic (lane 0..31 atomically add 1 at f[0], returning nothing), flag_store (store 1 at f[0] at agent scope), flag_plain (the same at wave scope), flag2_store (store 1 at f[4] at agent scope), value8 (later data stores 8), nop. Consumer ops: consume (load f[0] at agent scope, wait, load d[4 l] at wave scope, wait, store it at o[4 l]), consume_retry (as consume, but reload d until it reads 7), consume2 (as consume with f[4]). Every wave waits for all counters at its end. consumer_stored: the distinct values in o's first 32 dwords; fresh: the value the last data store wrote (anything else was served stale); events: the stale reads recorded.
